## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 These include internal Pali parallels in the *Dhammapada* (Dhp 153 and Dhp 154), the *Theragāthā* (Thag 1.78, *Meṇḍasirattheragāthā*), and the *Therīgāthā* (Thig 6.7, *Guttātherīgāthā*). Across canonical traditions, corresponding parallels are noted in the Sanskrit *Udānavarga* (UV 31 / UVS 31, *Cittavarga*), the Tibetan translation of the *Udānavarga* (*Ched du brjod pa'i tshoms*, D0326), and Chinese translations including the *Faju jing* (T 210.19), T 212.32, and the *Faji yaosong jing* (T 213.31).

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
